summary: P0 consumer review flow now works end-to-end. Quick demo consumer login persists user state, opening add-review-modal succeeds, rating + comment submits and modal closes, and the reviews list/count updates (from 4 to 5 avaliações). Backend regression 5/5 passing (auth+roles, search/detail/click/favorite, owner metrics+CRUD, admin metrics+RBAC, and new review persistence). UI regression passing: custom login (user@cidadehub.com), favorite toggle, RoleSwitcher (profile-open-role-switcher-btn -> role-option-store-owner) redirects to /owner/dashboard. Inline review-error-box in place; no Alert()/alert() usage in store/[id].tsx.
action_items: Optional: address React Native web console warning "shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow." (non-blocking; comes from lucide-react-native or shadow* usages).
Optional hardening: frontend/.env exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct for Expo web) rather than EXPO_BACKEND_URL from the deployment contract; document the naming or add both if needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend still uses fallback defaults for JWT_SECRET/MONGO_URL/DB_NAME; the environment contract prefers failing fast on missing config.
AuthContext.switchDemoRole reads process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL directly; consider centralizing via a config module to match the api.ts BASE_URL usage.
seed_data_creation: Added one TEST_ui_review_* review to store_1 and one TEST_ backend review to store_1 for persistence verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://city-shop-hub-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Set EXPO_BACKEND_URL to preview URL before running pytest. The P0 consumer -> add review flow is confirmed working end-to-end via Playwright (mobile 390x844).
rca_of_issue: Previous iteration failure was caused by (a) stale/missing user state after switchDemoRole and (b) suppressed errors + hidden alert() usage. Current fix chain works: switchDemoRole now throws on !res.ok, handleQuickDemo awaits it and only navigates on success (else shows auth-error-box), openReviewModal resets state and gates on user, and handleSubmitReview surfaces failures via inline review-error-box. Playwright run at 390x844 confirmed modal visibility, star selection (rating-star-btn-4), comment input, submit, modal close, and updated review count 4->5.
